# schema/lookback_progress — valid spec produces no diagnostics and exits 0
# No testserver needed; validate performs static analysis only.

exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
! stdout .

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

# NOTE: close-duplicate of bearer_simple.yml on the matrix axes (both
# bearer × none × latest_event_timestamp × json). This sibling sets the
# per-iteration `lookback` sub-variant; bearer_simple.yml omits it.

# Per-iteration lookback on latest_event_timestamp.
#
# Models the catalogue's "advance cursor to now() - lag every iteration"
# pattern (carbon_black_cloud alert_v7, mimecast, cisco_duo, openai). The
# first run uses initial.lookback for the bootstrap window; every subsequent
# iteration subtracts the per-iteration lookback from the latest-event
# timestamp before persisting cursor.last_timestamp.

state:
  fields:
    url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999"
    api_key:
      type: secret
      default: "test-token"

defaults:
  base_url: {ref: state.url}

auth:
  bearer:
    token: {ref: state.api_key}

requests:
  - method: GET
    path: /api/v1/events
    query:
      since: {ref: cursor.last_timestamp}

response:
  decode: json
  events_at: response.body.events

pagination:
  none: {}

progress:
  latest_event_timestamp:
    event_time:
      path: timestamp
    initial:
      lookback: "24h"
    lookback: "-30s"

error:
  mode: standard
